sentences.text: Constance Elaine Britton -LRB- née Womack ; born March 6 , 1967 -RRB- is an American actress , singer and producer .

Britton made her feature film debut in the independent comedy-drama film The Brothers McMullen -LRB- 1995 -RRB- , and the following year , she was cast as Nikki Faber on the ABC sitcom Spin City .	The Brothers McMullen	The Brothers McMullen	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	Spin City	Spin City
